image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel (Blenheim coloration) resting on a rumpled grey blanket. The dog is facing the camera with large dark eyes. It has long, silky ears with heavy feathering, a white blaze on the forehead, and rich chestnut/red patches around the eyes and ears. The background consists of vertical wooden slats.
